services.name: Rental Events
services.desc: MoAD and YBCA present THE NEXUS PARTY, the official party of SF/Bay Area Black Art Week and one of the season’s most anticipated nights. Join artists, cultural leaders, and art lovers from across the Bay Area for an unforgettable celebration featuring beats by DJ KREAM and DJ Jihaari. Come ready to dance, connect, and celebrate. DJ Kream is a global community organizer, event producer, creative, and Oakland, California native who is making waves and breaking boundaries with her signature genre-bending DJ style.
